Mass 0.781 +/- 0.04 solar masses from Egger et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-238 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...696A..28E/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM.
